scope: Shopify add-ons: hidden/published events, first ticket, single/multiple dates, quantities, capacity and checkout.

source_rule_checks.name: first ticket and event capacity determine the quantity bound
selected occurrence remaining capacity caps its quantity
sold-out occurrence has zero remaining quantity
ticket inventory caps a larger event
per-order limit caps a larger stock
overlapping add-ons are rejected with time conflicts off
server rejects quantities above the ticket maximum
